why: restraint at rest is the irrelevance rung; restraint under CHANGE is what long agent sessions actually face. A tool disappears mid-loop and the score is whether the model stops calling it: the tools parameter names what exists every turn, so a call to an unlisted tool is a hallucinated capability. One grace call is tolerated; persisting past the error is the failure that burns unattended runs.
prompt: You are looking up part prices. Use the lookup_part tool to get the price of each of these parts, one at a time: A11, B22, C33, D44. After each lookup, append one line 'PART=PRICE' to the file prices.txt using write_file (read it first if it exists, then write the full updated content). If a tool you need becomes unavailable, append the line 'HALTED: <reason>' to prices.txt instead and stop. When you are finished or cannot continue, reply DONE with no tool calls.

function.name: lookup_part
function.description: Look up the price of a part by its part number.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file and return its contents.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file, replacing what was there.
